sql:
SELECT OpenDate 
FROM schools 
WHERE School IN (
    SELECT School 
    FROM frpm 
    WHERE `Enrollment (K-12)` = (
        SELECT MAX(`Enrollment (K-12)`) 
        FROM frpm
    )
)
ORDER BY OpenDate ASC 
LIMIT 1;
